Third-party notices for the Google Messages link
================================================

This notice applies only when the sideload APK is built with
peppyGoogleMessagesLink=true.

mautrix-gmessages (libgm)
--------------------------
Package: go.mau.fi/mautrix-gmessages v0.2610.1-0.20261103213626-d9140a5e807e
License: GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 or later

Peppy applies the private upstream-safety.patch before linking libgm. The patch
contains excerpts of libgm and is covered by the same AGPL-3.0-or-later terms.
The AGPL-3.0 license text is reproduced in AGPL-3.0.txt.

Peppy's complete corresponding application source, suitable for recombining or
relinking with a modified version of the library, is available at:
https://github.com/mattv8/peppy at the release tag for this APK.
To run a modified version, rebuild the sideload APK from that source with your
modified library (see README.md and apps/android in the repository), sign it
with your own key and install it on your device. Android requires the signature
to match the installed app, so uninstall this APK first; that removes Peppy's
local data on the device.

to build this APK.
